notes.title: “REDNEG ALLSTARS SWING-BY EDITION” Ver1.21 Update
notes.content:

notes.title: REDNEG ALLSTARS SWING-BY EDITION Ver1.11 update
notes.content:
Thank you for playing REDNEG ALLSTARS SWING-BY EDITION.
We are pleased to announce the Ver. 1.11 update of this game.

The following changes have been made in this version.

・Changed the behavior of bosses in Practice Mode. Random movement of bosses in BOSS RUSH and ANOTHER DREAMER that may occur due to game progression timing will be randomized.

With this version change, some replays saved in Practice mode will no longer be reproduced.

notes.title: REDNEG ALLSTARS SWING-BY EDITION Ver1.10 update
notes.content:
Thank you for playing REDNEG ALLSTARS SWING-BY EDITION.
We are pleased to announce the Ver. 1.10 update of this game.

The following changes have been made in this version.

Each English expression has been completely updated.

notes.title: REDNEG ALLSTARS SWING-BY EDITION Ver1.07 update
notes.content:
Thank you for playing REDNEG ALLSTARS SWING-BY EDITION.
We are pleased to announce the Ver. 1.07 update of this game.

The following changes have been made in this version.

Added “Sound type (sound API)” to the settings screen.
Fixed a problem that the previous screen remains when returning to player select from the practice menu.
Fixed a problem in which the assigned button and the button for decision etc. may not respond when pressed at the same time on the menu screen etc.
Fixed a typographical error on the unlock screen.

notes.title: REDNEG ALLSTARS SWING-BY EDITION Ver1.06 update
notes.content:
Thank you for playing REDNEG ALLSTARS SWING-BY EDITION.
We are pleased to announce the Ver. 1.06 update of this game.

The following changes have been made in this version.

Fixed a problem in the tutorial where the decision button would not move through items.
Fixed an issue where the boss name was incorrect when saving a replay in practice mode.
Fixed an issue where replays in practice mode would not play correctly.
Fixed other minor typos.

notes.title: REDNEG ALLSTARS SWING-BY EDITION Ver1.05 update
notes.content:
Thank you for playing REDNEG ALLSTARS SWING-BY EDITION.
We are pleased to announce the Ver. 1.05 update of this game.

The following changes have been made in this version.

Fixed a problem that the player does not flash white in reverse mode.
Fixed a problem with the tutorial being displayed in challenge mode.
Fixed the display of mode select.
Fixed text in settings screen.
Fixed the text in the replay list.

notes.title: REDNEG ALLSTARS SWING-BY EDITION Ver1.04 update
notes.content:
Thank you for playing REDNEG ALLSTARS SWING-BY EDITION.
We are pleased to announce the Ver. 1.04 update of this game.

The following changes have been made in this version.

Added indication when checkpoints are updated in BOSSRUSH and ANOTHER DREAMERS.
Changed the BGM for every 10 consecutive endless wins.
Corrected a misdescription of mode select.

notes.title: REDNEG ALLSTARS SWING-BY EDITION Ver1.03 update
notes.content:
Thank you for playing REDNEG ALLSTARS SWING-BY EDITION.
We are pleased to announce the Ver. 1.03 update of this game.

The following changes have been made in this version.

The endless mode score ranking was not sorted correctly.

Based on this fix, we will initialize the score ranking in the endless mode.
Thank you very much for your challenge so far.
We look forward to your continued challenge to the ranking.

notes.title: REDNEG ALLSTARS SWING-BY EDITION Ver1.02 update
notes.content:
Thank you for playing REDNEG ALLSTARS SWING-BY EDITION.
We are pleased to announce the Ver. 1.02 update of this game.

The following changes have been made in this version.

Speedrun mode annotation is added to the mode select screen.
Fixed a problem that the number of glades in the data window is not reset.
Fixed a soft lock problem when opening the settings screen from the pause screen when the background is switched.

notes.title: REDNEG ALLSTARS SWING-BY EDITION Ver1.01 update
notes.content:
Thank you for playing REDNEG ALLSTARS SWING-BY EDITION.
We are pleased to announce the Ver. 1.01 update of this game.

In this version, we have made the following changes.

Fixed a problem that shots fired at a certain timing would have a higher attack power than expected.
Fixed an issue where the ranking is sent even if the user selects "No" when confirming the transmission of ranking.

With this modification, replays saved with Ver. 1.00 may not play properly.

notes.title: REDNEG ALLSTARS SWING-BY EDITION release started!
notes.content:
Starting today, June 21, 2024
REDNEG ALLSTARS SWING-BY EDITION
has been released.

Best regards.

notes.title: REDNEG ALLSTARS SWING-BY EDITION to be released June 21
notes.content:
We are pleased to announce that REDNEG ALLSTARS SWING-BY EDITION
will be released on June 21, 2024 Japan time.

In the full version, players will be able to fight a total of more than 60 unique bosses,
and a rich variety of challenging elements for deeper enjoyment.

Please wait for a while for the release.
